views.name: target_page_visits
views.body_sql:
SELECT 
    session AS session_id,
    path AS page_step,
    rowid AS visit_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp) AS visit_order
FROM form_log
views.description: extracts page visit events for the relevant registration steps, preserving session context and chronological or sequential order

views.name: sessions_with_valid_precedence
views.body_sql: SELECT session AS session_id, MIN(stamp) < MAX(stamp) AS has_valid_sequence FROM action_log GROUP BY session
views.description: evaluates per-session visit order to flag sessions where the initial step chronologically precedes the final step
